g.title: j2828878033
g.text: We get around to expanding this place

g.title: j2109550760
g.text: Hit me. Um. Not literally, though.

g.title: j2230585673
g.text: Thought you weren't that kind of person
Starting to make me want to rethink things..

g.title: j2818083579
g.text: Hah, just teasing. Don't get your hopes up.

g.title: j3913064196
g.text: Can I say I'm sorry? For what I said that upset you. I think I stepped in it good without realizing it.

g.title: j881557622
g.text: I was thinking maybe we build a greenhouse

g.title: j1906008782
g.text: Can't keep lecturing Arthur about moving on
If I don't do the same

g.title: j2258431168
g.text: Know it won't happen today or tomorrow
But just thinking might be nice

g.title: j1150083612
g.text: Oh, we could grow some fresh veggies.

g.title: j478571515
g.text: It'd be great for your panquecitos. :) Some time in the sun time without worrying about them.

g.title: j1566004865
g.text: I like it! But why a greenhouse?

g.title: j1733060360
g.text: Just don't make me regret it, eh babas?

g.title: j1225610079
g.text: Fresh food (Si como más pizza voy a gritar)

g.title: j264026409
g.text: Fresh food (Si como más pizza voy a gritar)

g.title: j874640848
g.text: That's so sweet, thinking of my panquecitos
I was thinking of something else, too

g.title: j3127131267
g.text: I remember she likes plants. I think she'd love it.

g.title: j745803398
g.text: I'm just glad you two have patched things up.

g.title: j1207278379
g.text: No necesitamos mantenerlo lúgubre y sucio
Rather she be talking to the plants instead of...

g.title: j3899946507
g.text: Hard sometimes to let things go
Rather she be talking to the plants than...

g.title: j2161108766
g.text: She and I haven't always been "besties"
Hard sometimes to let things go
Rather she be talking to the plants than...

g.title: j3946493511
g.text: But I've found that when she smiles
Probably more of su onda de bruja jajaja

g.title: j164095636
g.text: "Dead mall" doesn't need to be so literal
